description: Source code for NGAP connection handling in a 5G network component, managing N2 interface connections, message forwarding, and connection lifecycle.

classes.name: n2_rx_channel
classes.description: Adapter class to forward NGAP Rx PDUs from N2 GW to the CU-CP NGAP, signaling connection loss on destruction.

classes.name: n2_tx_channel
classes.description: Adapter class to forward NGAP PDUs to the N2 GW and manage the lifetime of the TNL connection.

classes.name: ngap_connection_handler
classes.description: Handles NGAP connection lifecycle, including establishing, losing, and removing N2 interface connections.

methods.name: connect_to_amf
methods.description: Establishes connection to the AMF, creating RX and TX notifiers.

methods.name: handle_connection_loss
methods.description: Dispatches handling of connection loss to the NGAP executor.

methods.name: handle_connection_loss_impl
methods.description: Performs cleanup and signals disconnection to other components.

methods.name: handle_tnl_association_removal
methods.description: Asynchronously handles removal of the TNL association, ensuring proper shutdown.
